sloka: अमी लक्ष्मण दृश्यन्ते चूताः कुसुम शालिनः ।विभ्रम उत्सिक्त मनसः स अङ्गरागा नरा इव ॥४-१-६०॥
transliteration: amī lakṣmaṇa dṛśyante cūtāḥ kusuma śālinaḥ ।vibhrama utsikta manasaḥ sa aṅgarāgā narā iva ॥4-1-60॥

translations.english: 'O Saumitri O' tiger among men look at the kinnaras wandering here and there, in the wonderful forest around the Pampa lake.
